title: My Favorite Meal
text: Hi! My name is Ella. Today I want rice and a hot dog for lunch. My brother likes noodles and pizza better. For dessert, we share a cake and some cookies. I drink juice, and my brother drinks milk. After lunch, we both want watermelon. It is a happy meal!

questions.question: What does Ella want for lunch?
questions.source_sentence: Today I want rice and a hot dog for lunch.

questions.question: What does Ella's brother like better?
questions.source_sentence: My brother likes noodles and pizza better.

questions.question: What do they both want after lunch?
questions.source_sentence: After lunch, we both want watermelon.
